listeningQuestions.audio: Body language varies from culture to culture.
opts: 肢体语言全世界都一样。

listeningQuestions.audio: Making eye contact can show interest and honesty.
opts: 眼神接触能表现兴趣和真诚。

listeningQuestions.audio: A warm smile can break down barriers between strangers.
opts: 温暖的微笑能打破陌生人之间的隔阂。

listeningQuestions.audio: In Japan, lowering your eyes can demonstrate respect.
opts: 在日本要一直直视长辈。
在日本低目可以表达尊重。

listeningQuestions.audio: Worried students often cross their arms in front of their chests.
opts: 焦虑的学生常把双臂抱在胸前。
焦虑的学生总是大声说话。

listeningQuestions.audio: When in doubt, watch how the local people behave.
opts: 拿不准时观察当地人怎么做。

quizQuestions.q: A wave of the hand is a common ____ for saying goodbye.
It is hard to ____ a real smile from a fake one.
Your face often ____ your true feelings before you speak.
A loud phone can easily ____ students from the lesson.
She enjoys ____ about body language in different cultures.
We look forward to ____ how gestures differ around the world.
You should avoid ____ this gesture in Brazil, as it is not polite.
The crucial thing is ____ body language in a way that suits the culture.

opts: 同一手势在不同国家可能含义不同。
quizQuestions.audio: The same gesture can mean different things in different countries.

opts: 盯着别人看太久没有问题。
盯着别人看太久可能被当作威胁。
盯着别人看是一种问候。
quizQuestions.audio: Staring at someone too long can be interpreted as a threat.

reading.passage: When Lucy moved to a new country, she could not speak the language at all. Instead of staying silent, she used simple gestures to greet people, ask for help and say thank you. A few months later, she had made many friends, proving that a smile and a kind gesture can speak louder than words.
reading.passageCn: 露西搬到一个新国家时,完全不会说当地语言。她没有保持沉默,而是用简单的手势来问候、求助和道谢。几个月后,她交了许多朋友,这证明微笑和友善的手势胜过千言万语。

questions.q: What did Lucy use to communicate at first?
What did Lucy do instead of staying silent?
opts: She used gestures to greet and ask for help.
She only spoke her own language.
A smile and a kind gesture can speak louder than words.

writing.prompt: Write 3-4 sentences about a gesture you often use. Say what it means and how people might understand it differently. Use at least one -ing form (gerund).
writing.promptCn: 用3-4句话介绍一个你常用的手势:它表示什么、别人可能怎样理解。至少用一个动名词(-ing)。

lines.text: How did you know? I didn't say anything.
lines.cn: 你怎么知道的?我什么都没说。

lines.text: Your body language told me. Your shoulders are slumped too.
lines.cn: 你的肢体语言告诉了我,你的肩膀也垮着。

lines.text: You're right. Thanks for noticing — talking about it does help.
lines.cn: 你说得对。谢谢你注意到——说出来确实有帮助。
